method: Scripted persona walkthroughs on the deployed practice API and browser engine/device emulations. No real social posts or human assistive-technology study.

personas.persona: First-timer on an iPhone from Instagram
findings: Navigation and action remain visible in the 390x844 and emulated keyboard views
Native share payload and PNG/caption fallback tested without posting
Simultaneous repeated request returns one claim
Retrying a taken request does not add another strike
Cold coordinator could return an empty private file after a successful claim; fixed and regression-tested
Keyboard-only three-win flow reaches the certificate
ARIA live status announces wins and errors
Axe AA checks, visible focus and 200% zoom pass
Calendar auto-picked label raised to 14px; low-power stamp retains accessible text
personas.limitation: Automated accessibility and keyboard simulation, not a VoiceOver or NVDA listening session.

findings: Live matrix runs in America/Vancouver and renders 7 PM PT for the 9 PM ET opening
Calendar reminder is 8:55 PM ET / 6:55 PM PT and daily
Google opens a composer; Apple download is explicitly labelled; Outlook has a single-event repeat note

personas.persona: Player trying to peek, script or replay
findings: Open files receive no claimed answers in ledger, certificate API/HTML or socket messages
Two contending players produce one winner and a named loser strike
Deletion requires confirmation, verification and rate limiting; original identity is removed
